tools.name: resolve_compliance
tools.description: Return the current signed Regulatory Compliance Object for an object in a jurisdiction. Deterministic. tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Return any RCO by record_id, including superseded records - the audit trail, retained byte-identical.

tools.name: list_rule_sets
tools.description: List the versioned rule sets in force and formerly in force for a jurisdiction: id, version, hash, effective dates, artifact URL. Never the regulation text.

tools.name: list_issuers
tools.description: Return the signed consortium issuer registry document, verbatim as published at consortium-10060.org/issuers.json.

tools.name: publish_record
tools.description: Publish a signed Regulatory Compliance Object to the partner rail (rco-a2a-cpg.ai). findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "publish_record" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Publish a signed Regulatory Compliance Object to the partner rail (rco-a2a-cpg.ai). The ONLY write path in the suite, and it accepts only what already verifies:…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_rule_sets · Private data: resolve_compliance, get_record, list_issuers, publish_record · Public sink: publish_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_rule_sets · Private data: resolve_compliance, get_record, list_issuers, publish_record · Public sink: publish_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
